reason: The plugin is primarily a client-side UI theme for DeepSeek Harness Web, not a backend tool or automation system. Evidence in the package metadata and README shows it is a web theme extension with visual/audio customization and UI controls, with effects and settings stored locally.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的主题插件，用于在客户端应用赛博朋克风格的界面与音效效果，并提供特效开关与静音等控制选项。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web UI theme plugin that applies Cyberpunk-style visual and audio interface effects, with controls for enabling features and muting behavior.

capabilities: Applies custom web UI theme and visual effects via DSH client patching.
Generates in-browser audio cues using Web Audio APIs for typing and message events.
Offers runtime toggles for individual effects and a global mute option in a control panel.
Persists user interface preferences in browser localStorage.
Applies high-motion visual animations (CRT scanlines, glitch, scrolling code background) and timed interference effects.

reasons.code: README describes a DeepSeek Harness web UI Cyberpunk theme with CRT, glow, relic interference, and code-style background effects.
README states client-side audio is synthesized in-browser and includes controls for mute and per-feature toggles.
Package manifest declares DSH web client injection and patch bundle, indicating UI-layer integration only.
Repository structure includes lib, assets, and cordis.patch.yml, matching a theme plugin distribution pattern.
